injuries.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
injuries.headline: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) out for several weeks with broken wrist
injuries.comment: Lane was seeing some promising usage before exiting with his injury, having a touchdown nullified by holding, another endzone target just out of his reach, and an 11-yard gain on his one reception. The Ravens are now short on receivers unless Zay Flowers, who also exited with an injury, can come back for next week's game. In his absence, expect more work for Rashod Bateman, Chris Moore, and potentially fellow rookie Elijah Sarratt.

injuries.name: Kyler Murray
injuries.headline: Kyler Murray (concussion) ruled out Sunday
injuries.comment: Murray suffered the apparent concussion in the first quarter after being hit by Green Bay safety Jevon Bullard, with backup Carson Wentz taking over behind center for head coach Kevin O’Connell.

injuries.name: Zay Flowers
injuries.headline: Zay Flowers (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
injuries.comment: Flowers had been sidelined since the second quarter while attempting to work through the hamstring injury an return for head coach Jesse Minter, hauling in five of his six targets for 150 receiving yards and one touchdown on the day.

injuries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
injuries.headline: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) ruled out with an ankle injury jury
injuries.comment: Cooper had a nice 30 yard snag in this game, but was taken off the field on a cart. Fantasy managers will need to monitor his situation as details come through.

injuries.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
injuries.headline: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) questionable to return
injuries.comment: Thomas Jr. suffered the apparent shoulder injury in the second quarter of the Week 1 contest, hauling in all three of his targets for 40 yards prior to exiting.

injuries.name: Christian Mahogany
injuries.headline: Christian Mahogany (knee) questionable to return
injuries.comment: Mahogany suffered the knee injury early in the first quarter of the Week 1 contest, with Ben Bartch taking over at left guard for head coach Dan Campbell against the Saints.

injuries.name: Myles Garrett
injuries.headline: Myles Garrett (knee) to undergo surgery, placed on injured reserve
injuries.comment: Garrett was stifled in Thursday night’s season opener while still being limited with the knee injury for head coach Sean McVay and will now miss at least the next four games.

injuries.name: Malik Davis
injuries.headline: Malik Davis (hip) placed on season-ending injured reserve
injuries.comment: It's a tough blow to the veteran running back, who worked his way up the depth chart past two much younger and potentially more intriguing prospects. He will now focus on returning in 2027, but his road will be much harder, as he will be nearly 29 when next season rolls around.

injuries.name: Josh Sweat
injuries.headline: Josh Sweat (knee) off injury report Week 1
injuries.comment: Sweat practiced fully on Friday. He appears to be fully healthy heading into the season.

injuries.name: Sedrick Van Pran-Granger
injuries.headline: Sedrick Van Pran-Granger (illness) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Pran-Granger was a full participant in practice. He'll be good to go for Sunday's season opener.

injuries.name: Grover Stewart
injuries.headline: Grover Stewart off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Stewart was a full participant in practice. He'll be good to go for Sunday's season opener.

injuries.name: Anthony Richardson Sr.
injuries.headline: Anthony Richardson Sr. (illness) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Richardson will backup Daniel Jones to open the season.

injuries.name: Drew Ogletree
injuries.headline: Drew Ogletree (neck) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Ogletree was a full participant in practice. He'll be good to go for Sunday's season opener.

injuries.name: AJ Haulcy
injuries.headline: AJ Haulcy (ankle) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Haulcy was a full participant in practice. He'll be good to go for Sunday's season opener.

injuries.name: Charvarius Ward
injuries.headline: Charvarius Ward off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Ward was limited in practice on Friday. He will be good to go on Sunday.

injuries.name: Deforest Buckner
injuries.headline: DeForest Buckner off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Buckner was eased in practice this week, including missing practice on Friday. He'll be good to go for Sunday's season opener.

injuries.name: Austin Ajiake
injuries.headline: Austin Ajiake (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
injuries.comment: Ajiake was a late addition to the injury report on Friday. His status is up in the air on Sunday.

injuries.name: Ashton Jeanty
injuries.headline: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Jeanty practiced in full all week. He should be good to go in his lead role to open the season.

injuries.name: Seydou Traore
injuries.headline: Seydou Traore (thumb/Achilles) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Traore was a full participant in practice on Friday. He'll be good to go in his depth role to open the season.

injuries.name: Dante Trader Jr.
injuries.headline: Dante Trader Jr. (hamstring) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Trader was a full participant in practice on Friday. He'll be good to go in his depth role to open the season.

injuries.name: Will Kacmarek
injuries.headline: Will Kacmarek (calf) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Kacmarek is good to go as had been reported.

injuries.name: Jakobi Meyers
injuries.headline: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) good to go for Sunday
injuries.comment: As expected, Meyers carries no injury designation ahead of Sunday's season opener and will be available to play against the Browns. His presence is further competition for Parker Washington and Brian Thomas Jr. in a crowded Jacksonville WR room.

injuries.name: Nnamdi Madubuike
injuries.headline: Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) ruled out Sunday
injuries.comment: Madubuike had his career threatened, but he was cleared this offseason to return. He'll figure to still be eased back by Baltimore.

injuries.name: Keaton Mitchell
injuries.headline: Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) off injury report for Sunday
injuries.comment: Mitchell has been dealing with a nagging hamstring injury for a while, but it appears he is finally over it, as he has received full clearance to suit up and play for the Chargers in their season opener. He will remain relegated to a depth role behind Omarion Hampton for the foreseeable future, however.

injuries.name: Calais Campbell
injuries.headline: Calais Campbell (rest) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Campbell will be a full-go for Sunday's season opener.

injuries.name: Brenen Thompson
injuries.headline: Brenen Thompson (hip) good to go for Sunday
injuries.comment: Thompson has been cleared to play for Sunday's game, meaning that his hip injury isn't a very serious issue at this point. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

injuries.name: Teddye Buchanan
injuries.headline: Teddye Buchanan (knee) ruled out Sunday
injuries.comment: Buchanan was limited in practice all week. It won't be enough for him to be cleared for the season opener.

injuries.name: Jonathan Greenard
injuries.headline: Jonathan Greenard (pec) won't play Sunday
injuries.comment: The veteran is going to be sidelined on Sunday. He's still recovering from an injury to his pec right now, and the team wants to give him all the time that he needs to rest and make a full recovery before playing. His absence will leave Philadelphia's defensive front slightly weaker than usual against the Commanders.

injuries.name: Eli Stowers
injuries.headline: Eli Stowers (hamstring) listed questionable for Sunday
injuries.comment: The rookie officially carries a questionable tag heading into the weekend because of his hamstring injury. He told reporters that he expects to play in Week 1, however, which indicates that he is trending the right way at this point. He won't be fantasy relevant even if active for this matchup, however.

injuries.name: Ronnie Harrison Jr.
injuries.headline: Ronnie Harrison Jr. (hamstring) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Harrison practiced in full on Friday. He is good to go as expected.

injuries.name: Isaiah Davis
injuries.headline: Isaiah Davis (knee) cleared to play Week 1
injuries.comment: Davis will be available to play in Week 1, as his knee injury is nothing more than a minor issue at this point. He isn't expected to have much of a role on Sunday, especially with Breece Hall (groin) fully healthy and set to play against the Titans.

injuries.name: Breece Hall
injuries.headline: Breece Hall (groin) off injury report for Sunday
injuries.comment: Hall is heading into the weekend entirely free of any injury designation ahead of the team's season opener against the Titans on Sunday. He shouldn't have any substantial limitations to his workload in this matchup, and he projects to be a high-quality fantasy asset in this game and beyond if he can stay healthy.

injuries.name: Zach Bako-Bewele
injuries.headline: Zach Bako-Bewele (knee) officially questionable for Sunday
injuries.comment: Bako-Bewele's knee injury may leave him sidelined on Sunday, as he is currently considered questionable to play because of it. Aaron Banks (knee) is also questionable for the season opener, so Green Bay's offense could find themselves weaker than usual up front in a tough matchup against their divisional rivals.

injuries.name: Jordan Morgan
injuries.headline: Jordan Morgan (knee) good to go for Sunday
injuries.comment: Green Bay will have their starting left tackle on Sunday, despite the fact that he was limited at practice earlier in the week due to a knee issue of some kind. His presence is important for a Green Bay offensive line that already finds itself banged up heading into the season opener.

injuries.name: Tyson Bagent
injuries.headline: Tyson Bagent (back) listed questionable for Sunday
injuries.comment: Bagent is at risk of missing Chicago's season opener on Sunday. He wasn't able to practice at all this week, so it seems that he has an uphill battle to be active this weekend. If he's ruled out, Case Keenum will serve as Chicago's backup in his absence.

injuries.name: Audric Estime
injuries.headline: Audric Estime (thigh) won't play Sunday
injuries.comment: The Saints will be without Estime on Sunday, who is going to be sidelined due to a nagging thigh injury of some kind. His absence isn't expected to have much of an impact from a fantasy perspective.

injuries.name: Zachariah Branch
injuries.headline: Zachariah Branch (hamstring) off injury report for Sunday
injuries.comment: The rookie was limited at practice earlier in the week due to a hamstring injury, but he is over it now and is off of the injury report ahead of Sunday's game. He isn't expected to be a strong fantasy option against the Steelers, however, especially with Cooper Rush set to start at QB for the Falcons in the absence of Tua Tagovailoa (oblique).

injuries.name: Jordan Hancock
injuries.headline: Jordan Hancock (quad) listed questionable Sunday
injuries.comment: Hancock returned to a limited practice on Thursday after being sidelined on Wednesday. He'll be a game-time decision on Sunday.

injuries.name: T.J. Sanders
injuries.headline: T.J. Sanders (knee) listed questionable Sunday
injuries.comment: Sanders did not practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday. He'll be a game-time decision on Sunday.

injuries.name: Ty Johnson
injuries.headline: Ty Johnson (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
injuries.comment: Johnson returned to practice on Friday. If he is cleared, he'll remain in a depth role in the Bills backfield.

injuries.name: Dadrion Taylor-Demerson
injuries.headline: Dadrion Taylor-Demerson (ribs) ruled out Sunday
injuries.comment: Taylor-Demerson did not practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday. He'll be sidelined for the season opener on Sunday.

injuries.name: Garrett Williams
injuries.headline: Garrett Williams (Achilles) ruled out Sunday
injuries.comment: Williams suffered a season-ending torn Achilles in Week 16 last year. He was limited in practice this week, so it's possible he'll be ready to go for Week 2.

injuries.name: Isaiah Adams
injuries.headline: Isaiah Adams (knee) ruled out Sunday
injuries.comment: Adams was unable to practice all week. He'll be sidelined for at least one game to start the season.

injuries.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
injuries.headline: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) will play in Week 1
injuries.comment: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) will play in Week 1

injuries.name: Klavon Chaisson
injuries.headline: K’Lavon Chaisson (knee) will play in Week 1
injuries.comment: Chaisson is good to go after progressing throughout the practice week without any setbacks for head coach Dan Quinn as the Washington defense will look to keep a strong Philadelphia ground game in check Sunday.

injuries.name: Tua Tagovailoa
injuries.headline: Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) ruled out Sunday
injuries.comment: Tagovailoa went down in practice on Thursday and did not practice on Friday. With Michael Penix Jr. not available yet, it will be Cooper Rush drawing the start on Sunday.

injuries.name: Daron Payne
injuries.headline: Daron Payne (knee) will play in Week 1
injuries.comment: Payne will suit up for head coach Dan Quinn after progressing through a short practice week without any issues. The defensive tackle will look to stifle a Philadelphia rushing attack led by running back Saquon Barkley and quarterback Jalen Hurts in the season opener.

injuries.name: Parker Brailsford
injuries.headline: Parker Brailsford (thumb) listed questionable Sunday
injuries.comment: Brailsford has been limited due to a thumb injury. The rookie's status will need to be monitored closer to Sunday.

injuries.name: Teven Jenkins
injuries.headline: Teven Jenkins (back) ruled out Sunday
injuries.comment: Jenkins was unable to practice this week due to a back injury. He'll miss at least one game to begin the season.

injuries.name: Emeka Egbuka
injuries.headline: Emeka Egbuka (toe) cleared for Week 1
injuries.comment: Emeka Egbuka (toe) cleared for Week 1

injuries.name: Jamarr Chase
injuries.headline: Ja’Marr Chase (knee) cleared for Week 1
injuries.comment: Ja’Marr Chase (knee) cleared for Week 1

injuries.name: Tee Higgins
injuries.headline: Tee Higgins (foot) cleared for Week 1
injuries.comment: Tee Higgins (foot) cleared for Week 1

injuries.name: Cedric Gray
injuries.headline: Cedric Gray (concussion) ruled out Sunday
injuries.comment: Gray was placed on concussion protocol earlier this week. He will miss at least one game as a result.

injuries.name: Joseph Ossai
injuries.headline: Joseph Ossai (foot) out for Week 1
injuries.comment: Ossai had been considered week-to-week with his foot injury. Now, it's been confirmed that he will miss the season opener. Ossai was a free-agent acquisition this offseason for the Jets after recording five sacks in each of the past two seasons for the Bengals.

injuries.name: Tim Patrick
injuries.headline: Tim Patrick (groin) out for Week 1
injuries.comment: Patrick has yet to return to practice, so it's no surprise that he will not play in Week 1. The veteran receiver signed with the Jets this offseason after catching 15 passes with three touchdowns over 16 games for the Jaguars last season.

injuries.name: Kene Nwangwu
injuries.headline: Kene Nwangwu (back) doubtful for Week 1
injuries.comment: Nwangwu has been dealing with a back issue and will likely sit out Sunday's game in Tennessee. Nwangwu does most of his work on special teams for the Jets. He has returned five kicks for touchdowns over his five seasons, including one last year.

injuries.name: D'Angelo Ponds
injuries.headline: D'Angelo Ponds (calf) doubtful for Sunday
injuries.comment: Ponds has been trying to make his way back in time for his first NFL game, but it looks like he will have to wait at least one more week. Ponds was selected in the second round of this year's draft by the Jets after winning a national championship at Indiana last season.
